notes: Add sodium to retain fluid; 1 kg lost needs about 1.25-1.5 L. Include a meal.
Use commercial ORS, not a sports drink. Seek care for blood, fever or signs of severe dehydration.

Address fatigue, conditioning and pacing first. Sodium may help only when dilute fluid intake is the trigger.

notes: Potassium-containing salts and high-sodium products can be dangerous. Individualise with the treating team.
